speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing intense itching and developing red bumps on your thigh and other body parts; can you tell me when these symptoms first appeared and if you have noticed any travel, insect bites, or exposure to new plants or animals?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chigger Bite Dermatitis (Trombiculosis). Given your recent travel to Miami and the clinical presentation of intense itching with red bumps on the thigh, these symptoms are highly consistent with an infestation of the larval stage of mites, which often go unnoticed at the time of the bite.
